C1486.title: Eclipse Attack Detection for Bitcoin Light Clients
C1486.summary: In permissionless blockchain systems like Bitcoin, light clients rely on peer-to-peer networks to receive transactions. If a client fails to connect to at least one honest node, it becomes vulnerable to an eclipse attack, where the adversary controls all its connections and feeds it a malicious forked blockchain view. This can lead to catastrophic business decisions based on distorted transaction

references.title: Decentralized Lightweight Detection of Eclipse Attacks on Bitcoin Clients
